shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' | head -200"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc "for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/globals.css app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/ProductGrid.tsx app/product/'[slug]'/page.tsx; do echo \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files | head -200 && git status --short && rg -n \"ViewTransition|Suspense|loading|Link|router|startTransition|addTransitionType|prefers-reduced-motion\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat lib/products.ts && rg -n "ViewTransition|addTransitionType|transitionTypes" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js node_modules/next/dist/client/app-router.js node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/router* 2>/dev/null | head -140'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"viewTransition|viewTransitions|transitionTypes|addTransitionType\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -140 && rg -n 'unstable_ViewTransition|ViewTransition' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -60"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('react').then(r => console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, unstable_ViewTransition:typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType, unstable_addTransitionType:typeof r.unstable_addTransitionType}))\" && node -e \"console.log(require('next/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.js node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"ViewTransition|viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router.js node_modules/next/dist/client/components/layout-router.js node_modules/next/dist/server/app-render -g '*.js' | head -120 && sed -n '2030,2105p' node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts && sed -n '165,187p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view react version && npm view react@canary version && npm view react-dom@canary version && npm view next@16.4.5 peerDependencies --json'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && npm view react@19.3.1 version && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version\" && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@types/react-dom/package.json').version\" && rg -n \"react-dom|react@|next\" package-lock.json | head -35"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"transitionTypes|ViewTransition|::view-transition-old\\(\\.\" node_modules/next -g '*.css' -g '*.tsx' -g '*.ts' -g '*.md' | head -120"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,355p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/view-transitions.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install react@19.3.1 react-dom@19.3.1'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app package.json && cat app/PageTransition.tsx'
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('react').then(r => console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType}))\" && npx tsc --noEmit"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- tsconfig.json && rg --files node_modules | rg '("'^|/)(playwright|puppeteer|chromium)(/|$)'"' | head -40 && which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome playwright 2>/dev/null || true && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run start'

/bin/bash -lc "ls -d /root/.cache/ms-playwright /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright /opt/google/chrome /usr/bin/chromium* 2>/dev/null || true; node -e \"for(const p of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer'])try{console.log(p,require.resolve(p))}catch{}\"; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "command -v firefox || true; command -v google-chrome-stable || true; command -v chromium || true; find /usr/bin /opt /root/.cache /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache -maxdepth 3 \\( -iname '*chrom*' -o -iname '*firefox*' \\) 2>/dev/null | head -30"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la | head -60 && git ls-files && git check-ignore -v .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null || true'
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && cat next-env.d.ts && rg -n \"product-image-morph|nav-forward|skeleton-exit\" .next/server/app -g '*.html' -g '*.rsc' | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show HEAD:tsconfig.json > tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

root = Path('/workspace')
build_dir = root / '.next'
if build_dir.is_dir() and (build_dir / 'BUILD_ID').is_file():
    shutil.rmtree(build_dir)
next_env = root / 'next-env.d.ts'
if next_env.is_file() and next_env.read_text().startswith('/// <reference types=\"next\" />'):
    next_env.unlink()
tsbuildinfo = root / 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'
if tsbuildinfo.is_file():
    tsbuildinfo.unlink()
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff --stat && npm ls react react-dom next --depth=0 && ls -d .next next-env.d.ts tsconfig.tsbuildinfo 2>/dev/null || true'
